description: A compact sky-apartment, twin to the others on this hall: a fold-away bed, a narrow galley, and the same floor-to-ceiling window selling the cold city back to you as a view. Sparsely fitted, waiting for a tenant.

window.description: A wide, clean pane with the district laid out below it, close enough to read the signage.
window.name: the window
